# Ankush Das (Loid) — Full-Stack Developer & Systems Enthusiast

Ankush Das, also known as Loid, is a full-stack developer and systems engineer based in West Bengal, India, and the Co-Founder & Chief Technology Officer of Sednium Technologies. His portfolio is published at https://loid.sednium.com/.

## Professional Summary

Ankush builds responsive web applications, robust backends, and developer tooling. His career started with a strong curiosity about how computers and networks operate under the hood. Working on mobile Linux environments early on taught him to write lean, efficient code without unnecessary bloat. Today he works across the entire stack: clean accessible web interfaces in React and TypeScript, high-performance backend services in Go and Node.js, and cryptographic/edge infrastructure at Sednium Technologies (created on January 20, 2024).

## Projects

### OnyxChat
- Tagline: Zero-knowledge encrypted messaging client.
- Description: A local-first Android chat application built on the S.H.I.E.L.D. protocol, featuring stateless routing and hardware-backed storage.
- Highlights:
  - Stateless message routing via Vercel Edge Functions with zero data retention.
  - Local-first SQLite database encrypted with AES-256-GCM via the Android Keystore.
  - Uses Firebase Cloud Messaging strictly as a blind push transport for ciphertext.
- Technologies: Kotlin, Jetpack Compose, Android, end-to-end messaging, serverless functions
- URL: https://onyxchat.sednium.com

### Blade Launcher
- Tagline: Next-generation mobile launcher for Minecraft: Java Edition on Android.
- Description: A refined, portrait-first Minecraft Java Edition client for Android engineered with isolated Java 8–26 runtimes, multi-renderer graphics pipeline, and dual Microsoft/offline accounts.
- Highlights:
  - Ergonomic vertical portrait UX with rapid launch controls anchored in the thumb zone.
  - Hardware-accelerated Vulkan (Zink / Turnip / VirGL) and NG-GL4ES render backends for 60+ FPS gameplay.
  - Built-in runtime manager downloading isolated OpenJDK 8 to 26 runtimes with automated JVM routing.
  - Split-process architecture isolating launcher UI (:main) from the game JVM (:game) for crash immunity.
- Technologies: Kotlin, Jetpack Compose, Android, Vulkan / GL4ES, OpenJDK, GPLv3
- URL: https://blade-launcher.sednium.com/

### S.H.I.E.L.D. Protocol
- Tagline: Six-layer zero-knowledge messaging architecture.
- Description: A defense-in-depth cryptographic framework designed to eliminate server-side data retention, identity correlation, and metadata leakage.
- Highlights:
  - Replaces real-world identifiers with non-deterministic 8-character hex Routing IDs.
  - Combines X25519 and ML-KEM-768 via HKDF-SHA256 for hybrid post-quantum encryption.
  - Runs alongside the Signal Double Ratchet to maintain per-message forward secrecy.
- Technologies: Protocol Design, Zero-Knowledge, Post-Quantum, System Architecture
- URL: https://sednium.com/shield

### KryptonIDE
- Tagline: Native Android integrated development environment.
- Description: A lightweight, touch-optimized environment designed to write, parse, and compile code directly on mobile devices.
- Highlights:
  - Built natively using Kotlin and Jetpack Compose.
  - Features incremental syntax parsing and an integrated PTY terminal bridge.
  - Optimized memory footprint for constrained mobile hardware performance.
- Technologies: Kotlin, Jetpack Compose, Mobile IDE, Terminal, Android
- URL: https://kryptonide.sednium.com

### Sednicon
- Tagline: Automated SVG optimization and cross-platform iconography API.
- Description: An asset delivery pipeline that compresses vector graphics and exports type-safe components.
- Highlights:
  - Automated SVGO optimization to reduce file sizes.
  - Generates tree-shakeable React components and Compose VectorDrawables.
  - Deployed as a multi-platform design utility via Vercel and Supabase.
- Technologies: HTML/CSS/JS, Headless API, Icon API, SVG Engine
- URL: https://sednicon.sednium.com
